fact: Lesotho is developing a National Artificial Intelligence Strategy and a Data Centre Blueprint, discussed at a five-day workshop in Maseru on 17 to 21 August 2026, to put its AI Policy, published on 17 August 2026, into practice.
title: Lesotho moves from AI policy to national strategy and digital infrastructure planning
publisher: CADE - Civil Society Alliances for Digital Empowerment
